rows.definition: The resume-package Go const holding the FAK_RESUME_CACHE_AFFINITY env-var name; the watchdog relaunch threads RelaunchCacheAffinityKey(session) onto the child env under this key (#5189).
rows.distinction: The Go const (name binding), distinct from FAK_RESUME_CACHE_AFFINITY the literal string it holds, and from the Anthropic managed-cache TTL upgrade.

rows.definition: The admission gate for a SELF-authored (agent-proposed) policy overlay: admitSelfTightenOverlay classifies the delta from the installed effective floor to the proposed one through policy.DiffAmendment and admits only a no-op or tighten-only verdict, so an agent's own authority may ratchet the capability floor tighter but never wider (#5181, epic #5170 Track F).
rows.distinction: Decides ADMISSION of an agent-authored proposal; the guard allow-overlay (guardApplyAllowOverlay) instead APPLIES an operator-authored widening to the running floor. Different author (agent vs operator), different act (refuse-or-admit vs apply), opposite direction (tighten-only vs widen). Also distinct from the launch-wide --core-lock-all posture, which clamps every channel for the whole session rather than judging one overlay.
